info.title: Immons.Tools.Maui.Inspector.Sync
info.description: Sync tool — companion dotnet tool for Immons.Tools.Maui.Inspector: watches the in-app inspector for live property edits and writes them back into your XAML source files (WYSIWYG loop, pairs with IDE XAML Hot Reload). Also the desktop half of the Memory view's heap dumps: runs dotnet-gcdump against the app and reports every type's counts, sizes and root paths back to the panel.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: Sync tool (maui-inspector-sync) — writes live MauiInspector edits back into your XAML sources.
x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Typical use: cd into your app's source folder and just run

options.name: --app
options.description:
Base URL(s) of running web inspectors, comma-separated or repeated
(skips scanning). One updater serves every device at once.

options.name: --host
options.description:
Extra place(s) to look, next to the scan: a device IP or name
(tries ports 9295-9309), host:port or a full URL; repeated or
comma-separated. Also from the MAUI_INSPECTOR_HOSTS variable.

options.name: --no-lan-scan
options.description:
Skip the subnet sweep (or MAUI_INSPECTOR_NO_LAN_SCAN=1) — localhost,
adb and --host only.

options.name: --src
options.description: Root folder that contains the XAML sources (searched recursively).

options.name: --from-now
options.description: Ignore edits made before the updater started.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would change without writing files.
